name: homeslice
description: Model your house once and show it as an interactive, exploded isometric 3D view in Home Assistant.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:browser && (test -x .venv/bin/python && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q || echo 'Python tests skipped: no .venv (see CONTRIBUTING.md)')
scripts.dev: vite build && echo 'Card: http://localhost:8123/dev/harness.html?demo=card  Editor: …?demo=editor' && python3 -m http.server 8123
